_what: Which Marketplace configuration holds each of Trillion's own tools, workflows, rules and event rules (scripts/build-starting-set.mjs writes records/starting-set-records.json from this and the shipped rows). configurations: slug → the words people read. sets: where a row comes from → the configuration that holds it (a tool's set is its records file name without `workshop-` and `-tool-records.json`; `workflows`, `rules` and `event-sources` are the others). ids: one row's configuration, which wins over its set. split_every: a group cut into numbered configurations (slug-1, slug-2) of that many, in id order. A configuration with no rows yet (trillion-background-care, trillion-your-computer) is left out until a package gives it some. core: always on, in no configuration. pinned: called by name in code until the job slots land (src/job-slots.mjs), so an account cannot remove them.
